title: LumenCore Cross-Agency Capability Statement Control
claim_boundary: This matrix is a source-bound control for reusing capability modules. It proves only the local controls and artifacts identified as PROVEN, keeps internal or dated evidence BOUNDED, keeps unsupported external conclusions NOT_PROVEN, and requires volatile facts to be reverified at ACTION_TIME. It is not an agency endorsement, past-performance record, clearance determination, ATO, FedRAMP authorization, CMMC status, field validation, savings finding, performance finding, offer, certification, upload, portal action, or submission.

claim_classes.PROVEN: A direct local control or artifact property supported by present, hash-receipted, current sources. This class never establishes an external outcome.
claim_classes.BOUNDED: A limited internal, dated, or proposed capability supported by named sources and an explicit non-promotion boundary.
claim_classes.NOT_PROVEN: A conclusion that the current evidence does not establish. It remains blocked until the specified independent and, where applicable, official evidence exists.
claim_classes.ACTION_TIME: A volatile legal, security, commercial, portal, or solicitation fact that must be checked against its current authoritative source immediately before use.

modules.title: Fail-Closed Review and Action Control
modules.reusable_claim: The repository contains explicit controls that block autonomous external action and require source-bound conformance before reviewer-ready promotion.
modules.boundary: This proves a local control property and current gate state only. It does not prove that an agency, customer, assessor, or prime accepted the control.

defense: No autonomous certification or portal action
Missing mission and security facts remain blockers

modules.title: Source Receipt and Claim Traceability
modules.reusable_claim: The repository can inventory local source artifacts with repository path, byte count, SHA-256, freshness state, and an explicit claim boundary.
modules.boundary: A local receipt establishes artifact identity and custody, not source authority, scientific validity, mission suitability, or external acceptance.

modules.title: Measured Source Intake
modules.reusable_claim: Current internal receipts can support source-availability, row-custody, and replay-scoping statements for the exact frozen intake.
modules.boundary: Internal source intake does not establish source authority, mission representativeness, external validation, or an operational outcome.

modules.title: Baseline and Candidate Replay Packaging
modules.reusable_claim: Repository artifacts can package named-baseline evaluation, retained failures, configuration identity, and bounded replay context for technical review.
modules.boundary: Existing results are internal replay evidence. They cannot be promoted into mission outcomes or external conclusions without a frozen independent evaluation.

modules.title: Bounded Reproducibility Handoff
modules.reusable_claim: A dated reproducibility capsule can serve as a handoff template for a specific branch, commit, dependency lock, and known-gap record.
modules.boundary: The dated capsule is not proof that the current release reproduces. It must be rebuilt and independently run for the exact release under review.

modules.title: Buyer-Authorized Evidence Sprint
modules.reusable_claim: LumenCore can propose a bounded evidence sprint around buyer-authorized data, frozen metrics, source custody, retained failures, and human-owned acceptance states.
modules.boundary: This is an engagement design, not proof of prior delivery, customer acceptance, deployment, or a promised result.

modules.title: Full Live-Domain Service Chain
modules.reusable_claim: End-to-end public service health is not established by the current service-contract receipt.
modules.boundary: Individual reachable pages or feeds cannot be generalized into an all-endpoint availability or deployment-readiness statement.

modules.title: Independent External Outcome Validation
modules.reusable_claim: The current repository does not establish independently reproduced field outcomes, customer economics, or official acceptance.
modules.boundary: Local tests, hashes, internal replay, public-source breadth, and self-authored packets cannot substitute for a named outcome-independent evaluator and accepted external result.

modules.title: Current Submission Readiness
modules.reusable_claim: A polished capability statement does not establish current opportunity conformance, mandatory qualifications, or upload readiness.
modules.boundary: The official notice, attachments, amendments, route, format, qualifications, representations, price, and authority must all pass independently.

modules.title: Action-Time Authority and Fact Lock
modules.reusable_claim: Recipient, official instructions, deadline, route, signer authority, representations, security facts, price, and commitments must be reverified immediately before use.
modules.boundary: No frozen matrix authorizes a send, upload, portal action, signature, certification, offer, or submission.

restricted_claims.label: Agency endorsement or approval
restricted_claims.required_evidence: A current written determination from the named agency with scope and authority verified.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Repository receipts and correspondence do not establish endorsement.

restricted_claims.label: Federal past performance
restricted_claims.required_evidence: Verifiable contract identifiers, customer authority, scope, period, role, and accepted outcome records.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Prepared packets and outreach are not contract performance.

restricted_claims.label: Personnel or facility clearance
restricted_claims.required_evidence: Current official clearance records from the responsible authority for the exact entity and personnel scope.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: No local statement can establish clearance.

restricted_claims.label: Authority to Operate
restricted_claims.required_evidence: A current signed authorization package from the responsible authorizing official for the exact system and boundary.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Architecture, controls, and tests are not an ATO.

restricted_claims.label: FedRAMP authorization
restricted_claims.required_evidence: Current official marketplace or agency authorization evidence for the exact cloud service and impact level.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Cloud deployment or security design does not establish FedRAMP authorization.

restricted_claims.label: CMMC status
restricted_claims.required_evidence: Current authoritative CMMC or SPRS evidence for the exact entity, level, scope, and affirmation requirement.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: The existing packet records missing official proof and unresolved applicability.

restricted_claims.label: Field validation
restricted_claims.required_evidence: A preregistered external protocol, buyer- or evaluator-owned held-out data, accepted baseline and metric, named outcome-independent evaluator, and signed result receipt.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Internal replay and public-source breadth are not field validation.

restricted_claims.label: Realized savings or economic benefit
restricted_claims.required_evidence: Audited before-and-after costs, accepted counterfactual, exclusions, denominator, period, and customer or independent verification.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Modeled opportunity, replay deltas, and avoided-cost scenarios are not realized savings.

restricted_claims.label: Operational performance or superiority
restricted_claims.required_evidence: A frozen externally accepted protocol, representative held-out data, named baselines, uncertainty and adverse-case analysis, and independent result receipt.
restricted_claims.current_boundary: Internal benchmark and replay records cannot be generalized into operational performance.
